title: Git in three words: edit, stage, commit
why_it_matters: The mental model matters more than the commands.
explanation: You edit files in your working folder. git add moves chosen changes to the staging area. git commit saves that staged snapshot to history. Staging lets you commit related changes together instead of everything at once.
code:
git add index.html
git commit -m "Add hero section"
git log --oneline
try_it: Make a tiny change and walk through all three steps.
